description: Implementation of StorageManager class handling storage creation, retrieval, deletion, and clearing, with telemetry and logging features.

classes.name: StorageManagerImplementation
classes.description: Class implementing storage management functionalities including create, retrieve, delete, and clear storage, with telemetry and logging.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the storage manager with the provided service, setting paths and initializing telemetry.

methods.name: CreateStorage
methods.description: Creates storage for a specified app ID and size, returning the storage path.

methods.name: GetStorage
methods.description: Retrieves storage information and location for a given app ID.

methods.name: DeleteStorage
methods.description: Deletes storage for a specified app ID.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears storage for a specified app ID.

methods.name: ClearAll
methods.description: Clears all storage except for exempted app IDs.
